scope: All eight residual poluč-family tokens in the current Latin reader.
choice: Replace the East-heavy poluč-family contextually with official type-1 dobyti/dobyvati forms or a direct syntactic recast: dobudemo, dobivaje se, dobivajut se, dobil, an explicit reference to the decomposition from item 2, and direct prověriti/Ty rezultaty constructions.
motivation: The official lexicon supplies dobyti and dobyvati for get/obtain with broad East, West, and South cognate support. The eight inherited poluč- forms add an avoidable Russian/Bulgarian-looking layer, while their mathematical meanings are fully recoverable from local sentence context. Contextual recasts avoid manufacturing uncertain participles.
alternatives_rejected: Blindly inflect one replacement stem across all eight contexts; two sites are passive participles and are clearer as direct finite or prepositional constructions.
Retain poluč- merely because it is intelligible to East and part of South Slavic; the official type-1 dobyti family gives broader independent-family recognition.
Use získati, which favors West Slavic and would simply move the imbalance rather than repair it.

evidence.in_corpus_productive_family: The reader already uses dobudemo, dobil/dobili, dobiva se, dobivajut se, dobivamo and dobivajemo extensively in the same mathematical register.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
